row.notes: vmulss xmm9,xmm8,xmm0 in Car_Powertrain_Step: xmm0 = engine drive torque per full throttle = RevsPowerSpline(rad/s / revs_scale) x power_scale / rad/s (0 below 1e-6 rad/s, branch from 0x1446e275f lands here), xmm8 = turbo/assist factor, rbx = Engine system (CarEngine), xmm7 = rad/s. Scaling xmm0 here scales engine power for this car without touching the obfuscated spline. 4-byte insn. Duplicated notes/evidence and the stale no-signature remark removed per V1249
